newsitem.title: UK: British '96 cereal crop area up 4.8 pct - MAFF.
newsitem.headline: British '96 cereal crop area up 4.8 pct - MAFF.

text.p: The total area planted to British cereal crops excluding maize in the year to June 1996 rose to 2.794 million hectares against 2.665 million in 1995, latest provisional data from the Ministry of Agriculture Food and Fishery (MAFF) showed.

The bulk of the cereal crop area was taken up by wheat with 1.840 million hectares, a rise of 6.2 percent on the 1995 area, and barley 869,000 hectares, up 3.8 percent after a sizeable winter area rise was followed by a drop in spring sowings.
MAFF commented that the increased cereal crop area followed reductions in EU set-aside rates.

Also included in the MAFF statistical review was maize at 104,000 hectares, up 3.8 percent, sugar beet 199,000 hectares, up 1.3 percent, potatoes 136,000 hectares, up 4.1 percent, and oilseed rape 312,000 hectares, up 4.1 percent from the year to June 1995.
